title: The Haldane Conjecture on Spectral Gaps of Antiferromagnetic Quantum Spin Chains
exact_target: Does the isotropic antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chain have a bulk energy gap exactly for integer, rather than half-integer, spin?

sources.citation: Marius Lemm and Angelo Lucia, On the critical finite-size gap scaling for frustration-free Hamiltonians, Review of Mathematical Physics 37 (2025), introduction.
